# A foreign item starts only in the sandbox on a build host declared credentials = "none". The real wiring reads who wrote the item through gh.
# The fake gh answers the author read with the value of ASSOC, and the open pull request of the item with the number in PULL.
isolate

subst fake/gh
chmod 755 fake/gh

# A project whose tracker is on GitHub reads the author of the issue even with no forge key: with the sandbox off, a foreign issue is refused before the claim.
env ASSOC=CONTRIBUTOR
env PULL=
exitcode 1 beehavereal run 412 issues-off --workflow flow/pass.star
stderr 'item 412 was not started: its issue #412 comes from another account \(CONTRIBUTOR\)'
stderr 'Remove sandbox = "off" from the project'
! stdout 'finished'
grep 'issueOrPullRequest' gh.log
noclaims issues-off

# The same project with the sandbox on and no build host declared credentials = "none" is refused too.
exitcode 1 beehavereal run 413 issues-on --workflow flow/pass.star
stderr 'item 413 was not started: its issue #413 comes from another account \(CONTRIBUTOR\)'
stderr 'the project declares no build host with credentials = "none"'
! stdout 'finished'

# A local item of a project with a forge whose pull request comes from another account, in the sandbox with no declared host: the host check of the build refuses it.
env PULL=77
exec beehavereal item add pulls-on fix-login --title 'Fix the login' --body-file body.txt
exitcode 1 beehavereal run fix-login pulls-on --workflow flow/pass.star
stderr 'item fix-login was not started: its pull request #77 comes from another account \(CONTRIBUTOR\)'
stderr 'the project declares no build host with credentials = "none"'
! stdout 'finished'
noclaims pulls-on

# The owner's own issue starts with the sandbox off.
env ASSOC=OWNER
env PULL=
exec beehavereal run 414 issues-off --workflow flow/pass.star
stdout 'item 414 finished'

# A read of the pull request of another item reads no author. The fake fails the author read of #88, the pull request of the item other-item, and the run
# finishes: it read the pull request of the other item, and it asked for the author of no pull request.
exec beehavereal item add pulls-on read-other --title 'Read another item' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run read-other pulls-on --workflow flow/other.star
stdout 'item read-other finished'
grep 'pr view 88' gh.log
! grep 'graphql.*p=88 ' gh.log

# The same fake does fail that author read when a run asks for it: the item other-item itself, whose pull request is #88, is refused at its start.
exec beehavereal item add pulls-on other-item --title 'The other item' --body-file body.txt
exitcode 1 beehavereal run other-item pulls-on --workflow flow/pass.star
stderr 'item other-item was not started: beehave cannot read who wrote it'
grep 'graphql.*p=88 ' gh.log

-- body.txt --
Fix the login.
-- flow/pass.star --
def main(item):
    pass
-- flow/other.star --
def main(item):
    pr_read(id = "other-item")
-- config/projects/issues-off.star --
project(
    repo        = "o/r",
    base_branch = "main",
    gate        = "true",
    test_report = "r/*.xml",
    tracker     = "github",
    sandbox     = "off",
)
-- config/projects/issues-on.star --
project(
    repo        = "o/r",
    base_branch = "main",
    gate        = "true",
    test_report = "r/*.xml",
    tracker     = "github",
)
-- config/projects/pulls-on.star --
project(
    repo        = "o/r",
    base_branch = "main",
    gate        = "true",
    test_report = "r/*.xml",
    forge       = "github",
)
-- fake/gh --
#!/bin/sh
# The stand-in for gh: every call is logged, the author read answers ASSOC, and the open pull request list answers PULL when it is set.
# The item other-item has the open pull request #88, and the author read of #88 fails.
echo "$*" >> "@WORK@/gh.log"
case "$*" in
  "auth token"*) echo fake-token ;;
  *graphql*"p=88 "*) echo 'graphql: error' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  "pr list"*"--head other-item --state open"*) echo '[{"number":88}]' ;;
  "pr view 88"*) echo '{"number":88,"state":"OPEN","headRefOid":"abc123","baseRefName":"main","author":{"login":"someone"},"assignees":[],"labels":[],"reviews":[],"reviewRequests":[],"isDraft":false,"body":""}' ;;
  *graphql*issueOrPullRequest*) printf '{"data":{"repository":{"issueOrPullRequest":{"authorAssociation":"%s"}}}}\n' "$ASSOC" ;;
  "pr list"*"--state open"*) if [ -n "$PULL" ]; then printf '[{"number":%s}]\n' "$PULL"; else echo '[]'; fi ;;
  "pr view"*) echo '{"number":77,"state":"OPEN","headRefOid":"abc123","baseRefName":"main","author":{"login":"someone"},"assignees":[],"labels":[],"reviews":[],"reviewRequests":[],"isDraft":false,"body":""}' ;;
  "issue view"*) echo '{"number":412,"title":"Fix it","state":"OPEN","labels":[],"assignees":[],"body":"Fix it."}' ;;
  *) echo '[]' ;;
esac
